sections.title: A commitment to Africa, a vision for health
paragraphs: My journey has always been guided by a deep conviction: Africa's renewal will come from its leaders' ability to turn structural challenges into sustainable development opportunities.

As Founding President of Jeunes Leaders d'Afrique, I have devoted my public life to giving a voice to a new generation—one that no longer waits for change but drives it to build a sovereign, modern and prosperous continent. This passion for African renewal is the essence of my entrepreneurial commitment.

sections.title: Why create AMS – Africa Med Supply?
paragraphs: Access to quality health care is the foundation of any emergence. Yet the pharmaceutical market in West Africa still faces structuring and safety challenges.
I created AMS with a clear mission: to secure the health supply chain by becoming the strategic bridge between Europe and Africa.

My ambition is to build a bridge of trust. By combining the excellence of European laboratories with our rigorous command of the Ivorian field, we ensure that every medicine and device arrives with full traceability and efficiency.

sections.title: Ambition beyond commerce
paragraphs: For me, Africa Med Supply is far more than a distribution company. It is a concrete response to the need for health sovereignty. It shows that strong local expertise, together with transparent international partnerships, can durably improve daily life for our populations.
We do not merely distribute products; we build an ecosystem where health becomes the primary driver of African development.

sections.title: A modern vision for health in Africa
paragraphs: My professional path has always been guided by a strong belief: Africa's development depends on companies' ability to combine innovation, rigour and operational excellence.
Through my experience in management, information systems and strategic development, I am convinced that a high-performing organisation must be built on trust, transparency and efficiency.
That vision guides my commitment at Africa Med Supply today.

sections.title: Why AMS – Africa Med Supply?
paragraphs: Health is a major stake for our continent's future. Yet challenges in supply, traceability and quality of medical products remain significant in West Africa.
By joining Africa Med Supply as Managing Director, I chose to help build a company that delivers reliable, modern and lasting solutions for health-sector stakeholders.
Our ambition is clear: to guarantee secure access to medicines and medical devices that meet the most demanding international standards.

sections.title: A company focused on excellence
paragraphs: Africa Med Supply is more than a distribution company. We are building a structured, innovative organisation resolutely focused on the future.
By combining local expertise, modern technologies and strong strategic partnerships, we help strengthen the medical supply chain in Africa.
Every AMS action reflects one essential priority: making health a true driver of economic and social development for our continent.

cases.title: Antimalarial Product Deployment
cases.challenge: Deploy a new antimalarial treatment across Côte d'Ivoire with full regulatory compliance and rapid market penetration.
cases.solution: Implemented an integrated regulatory-to-distribution pathway, achieving product registration in record time and establishing a nationwide distribution network.

cases.title: National Distribution of Injectable Products
cases.challenge: Establish cold chain distribution for temperature-sensitive injectable products across multiple regions in West Africa.
cases.solution: Deployed certified cold chain infrastructure with real-time temperature monitoring and last-mile delivery capabilities.

cases.title: Medical Devices Supply Chain
cases.challenge: Create an efficient supply chain for medical devices with complex import requirements and hospital distribution needs.
cases.solution: Developed a comprehensive supply chain solution including customs clearance, warehousing, and direct hospital delivery.
